title: Media Buying Briefing: Gen AI creative emerges as new battleground between TV and platforms

facts.fact: The article was published on September 29, 2025, and is credited to Sam Bradley.
According to the article, TV broadcasters and walled garden platforms are competing to lower the cost of ad creative.
facts.quote: TV broadcasters and walled garden platforms are competing to lower the cost of ad creative.

facts.fact: The article names Amazon, Google, Comcast, ITV and Channel 4 as each hoping to capture a share of the long tail of ad spend.
facts.quote: Amazon, Google, Comcast, ITV and Channel 4 are each hoping to capture their share of the long tail of ad spend

facts.fact: The article states that AI removes a longstanding barrier to entry for small business advertisers.
facts.quote: as AI removes a longstanding barrier to entry for small business advertisers.

facts.fact: The article says media agencies do not necessarily benefit from the competition over ad creative, but have incentives to encourage clients to use these options.
facts.quote: Although media agencies don’t necessarily benefit from the competition, there are incentives for them to encourage clients to use these options

facts.fact: The Media Buying Briefing series is distributed by email to Digiday+ members every Monday at 10 a.m. ET.
facts.quote: is distributed over email every Monday at 10 a.m. ET.
